purpose: No-model native control of Codex skill-disable entry paths; no historical result changes.

isolation.copied_files: Only the nine listed public SKILL.md files; no config or credential files.

method.command: sandbox-exec -p NETWORK_POLICY EVAL_NATIVE_CODEX -C TEMP_WORKSPACE debug prompt-input SYNTHETIC_PROMPT with configuration(TEMP_CODEX_HOME,TEMP_WORKSPACE,medium) overrides
method.negative_control: Replace only skills.config entry-file paths with their parent directories, matching the frozen06 bug.
method.scope: Native debug prompt-input with offline configuration. Same skill paths and disabled features as paired configuration; omit managed proxy listeners so all network can be denied. This is not a paid codex exec replay.

conclusions: Directory paths do not disable the advertised skill entries; SKILL.md entry paths do.
Eight of nine mirrored public entries were advertised under the old configuration; review-agent was not advertised.
Real HOME .agents skill paths and an arbitrary workspace guidance skill were absent in these native controls.
configuration() is shared by both comparison arms. Its selected arm guidance is explicitly appended once by run_agent(); it is not registered as an automatic skill.
limitations: These controls establish native prompt catalog visibility, not the contents of discarded historical model transcripts.
No claim that ambient skills caused file-read loops, changed success rates, or caused a quantified billed token difference.
No historical results are rescored; a fresh comparison is needed after the isolation correction.
